group_position: the only shot of grp005 — Alice runs her whole map line here: start sitting_shelf -> path meadow -> end field_way. The sister holds her map start and never moves.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: sitting bolt upright on the grass at sitting_shelf, then up and away across the meadow
characters.space_fragment_en: sitting bolt upright on the grass at the sister's sitting place on screen-right, then scrambling up and running out toward the open meadow
characters.facing: first out to screen-right after the animal, then up and across to her sister at screen-left, then away down the meadow with her back to camera

path.to: on her feet on the flattened grass at the sitting place
out of the bottom of frame, running across the open meadow toward the way across the field to the hedge

beats.action: stares after the animal down the meadow
turns her look up and across to her sister
runs out of the bottom of frame
beats.sync: exit; the frame is left with the sister, the book and one daisy

performance_beat.objective: get someone to confirm what she saw — and, when nobody does, go after it herself
performance_beat.goal: get her sister to confirm what she saw
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from startled disbelief, through a beat of being entirely unwitnessed, to reckless decision

trigger.beat: her look reaches her sister and is not returned

performance_beat.end_state: out of frame — the last visible state is her back going away, head up, one fist closed in her skirt

characters.label: Alice's Sister
characters.start_pos: upright at sitting_shelf under the northern elm, unchanged
characters.space_fragment_en: sitting upright at the sister's sitting place under the northern elm, small on screen-left, eyes down on the book
characters.facing: square to the backwater, head bowed; her eyeline never rises

beats.action: still reading after Alice has gone

performance_beat.emotional_arc: from absorbed to absorbed — the absence of reaction is the whole function of the performance

trigger.beat: Alice runs out of frame beside her

performance_beat.end_state: head still bowed to the page, eyes on the print, shoulders unmoved

presence_check.story_event: ev0001 (real_frame, T0) — 'burning with curiosity, Alice runs after it across the field'
presence_check.note: Alice leaves the riverbank here and does not return in ep01. The sister stays on the bank and appears in no later ep01 shot.
